title: Google is connecting Wallet to AI Mode in Search, and Drive and the Gemini app come next

title: Google expands Search AI Mode to integrate Wallet, Drive and Gemini
description: New Delhi: Google is expanding its Personal Intelligence feature in Search's AI Mode by adding support for Google Wallet, Google Drive and the Gemini app to provide personalised responses based on users' data. The company began rolling out Google Wallet integration on November 23, with support for Drive and Gemini to follow in the coming weeks. The three applications will join Gmail, Google Calendar and Google Photos, which are already integrated with Personal Intelligence. The update was announced by Robby Stein, Vice President of Product, Google Search, in an official blog post. With Google Wallet integration, users can seek recommendations based on their spending patterns, financial goals and credit card benefits, including cashback, travel perks and reward points. Google clarified that AI Mode will have read-only access to Wallet information and will not be able to transfer, manage or invest users' money. The upcoming Google Drive integration will allow AI Mode to draw information from users' documents, spreadsheets and PDFs when responding to queries. The Gemini integration will enable users to carry context between conversations in the Gemini app and Search's AI Mode. Google is also introducing personalised responses in AI Overviews and AI Mode based on users' recent search activity, allowing them to continue their research across separate search sessions. Connecting applications to Personal Intelligence will remain optional. Users can enable or disable individual integrations through their Search Personalisation settings. Google will also introduce an option for users to view the personal context used to generate a response through a Personalisation icon displayed below it.
